title.en: Building Maintenance and Strata Management (HDB Privatised Estates — Exemption) Order

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Building Maintenance and Strata Management (HDB Privatised Estates — Exemption) Order.

heading.en: No initial period for former HUDC housing estates

text.en: 3. Every exempt management corporation that is constituted for any housing estate formerly subject to the HUDC Housing Estates Act (Cap. 131) shall be exempt from section 49 of the Act.

heading.en: Shorter initial period for other estates

text.en:
4. Subject to paragraph 3, every other exempt management corporation shall be exempt from section 49 of the Act from whichever following day is the earlier:
(a)the 91st day after the day on which the exempt management corporation is constituted; or
(b)the day when the first annual general meeting of the exempt management corporation is held.

heading.en: No first annual general meeting for former HUDC housing estates

text.en: 5. The HDB shall be exempt from section 26 of the Act in respect of any exempt management corporation that is constituted for any housing estate formerly subject to the HUDC Housing Estates Act.

heading.en: First annual general meeting for other estates

text.en:
6.—(1) Subject to paragraph 5, the HDB shall be exempt from section 26(1) of the Act in respect of every other exempt management corporation on condition that the HDB holds the first annual general meeting of the exempt management corporation from whichever following day is the earlier:
(a)a day that is within 90 days after the exempt management corporation is constituted; or
(b)a day that is 6 weeks after the HDB receives a written request from the subsidiary proprietors of at least 10% of the total number of lots comprised in that exempt management corporation’s strata title plan asking for the first annual general meeting to be held.
(2) The HDB shall be exempt from following the agenda specified in section 26(3)(f) of the Act for the first annual general meeting of an exempt management corporation, on condition that the agenda includes instead, the item of receiving and, if considered fit, of adopting the audited annual accounts of the exempt management corporation for the period —
(a)starting from the date the exempt management corporation is constituted; and
(b)ending on a date not earlier than 60 days before its first annual general meeting.
(3) The HDB shall be exempt from the duty under section 26(4) of the Act of placing before the first annual general meeting of, and from delivering to, an exempt management corporation any document or record referred to in paragraph (a)(ii), (v), (vii) or (viii) of section 26(4) of the Act.
[G.N. No. S 198/2005]
